question: Design a Multi-Persona AI Banker as a shared AI platform with persona-aware specialization across Retail, SME, and CFO personas - not three independent agents. The platform shares orchestration, memory, tooling, and governance; persona differences mainly affect permissions, context, tone, workflows, and proactive behavior. Cover: API gateway and auth, identity resolution, shared agent orchestrator, context manager with persona-aware injection, tool router, policy engine, layered memory (session, long-term user, financial-historical, organizational context), notification orchestrator, audit and monitoring, deterministic vs probabilistic boundary for financial math, proactive intelligence with cooldowns and fatigue prevention, human-in-the-loop for medium/high-risk actions, failure modes (false positives, hallucinations, persona misresolution, notification fatigue, tool misuse), event-driven scalability, and rollout strategy starting with Retail.

anchors: LangGraph/LangChain ReAct agent runtimes with DAG orchestration, tool-calling, durable execution, 10K+ agent runs/day (resume.txt L51-54, blackbox-experience.md #7-#11)

LLMOps telemetry mesh: 50M spans/day, 2.5TB monthly trace data, deterministic replay, 60% MTTR cut (resume.txt L58-59, blackbox-experience.md #20)

scope: Shared multi-persona AI Banker platform serving Retail, SME, and CFO personas from one runtime
Persona-aware context injection: permissions, tone, workflows, proactive cadence - not separate agents
Supervisor + specialist subagents: cashflow forecaster, spending coach, treasury advisor, payroll-readiness, anomaly explainer, governance/approval agent, advisory/coaching agent
Deterministic vs probabilistic boundary: financial math (balances, runway, FX, payroll) runs in a deterministic Calculation Service; LLMs do reasoning, prioritization, summarization, NL surface

Tool layer (RBAC per persona): bank account API (Plaid/Account-Aggregator), accounting (Tally/Zoho/QuickBooks), payroll (RazorpayX/Gusto), treasury (FX, sweep, MMF), GST/IT portals, payment rails (UPI/ACH/SEPA), notification channels
Layered memory: session, long-term user, financial-historical (transactions), organizational-context (treasury, vendor, approval graph)
Proactive intelligence: event-driven nudges from salary credits, budget breaches, FX exposure, treasury imbalances; prioritization, cooldowns, fatigue prevention
Human-in-the-loop: low-risk auto, medium-risk queued for review, high-risk approval workflows with audit and recoverability
Knowledge base ingestion: transaction history, invoice OCR, bank statements, contract terms, regulatory rulebook (compliance RAG)
Guardrails: prompt-injection defense (input + tool-output), PII redaction, confidence-scored actions, hallucination gate on advisory output, behavioral policy enforcement
Multi-tenant isolation per entity (consumer / business / corp), data residency (DPDP/RBI/SOC-2)
Observability: per-step traces, deterministic replay, eval harness for advice quality and forecast accuracy
Rollout strategy: Retail first (lowest risk), then SME, then CFO; reusable abstractions from Day 1

interviewContext.evaluation: ambiguity handling, AI systems thinking, scalability, safety, architecture trade-offs, staff-level ownership
interviewContext.biggestPitfall: designing three separate agents instead of a shared platform; using LLMs for deterministic financial math
